programme.sub-title: S01 : E73 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 73
programme.desc: Necip viene ricattato da Ismail e dal suo complice, che gli chiedono soldi in cambio di Nazim. Nel frattempo Sinan riceve un messaggio e parte alla ricerca del bambino, insieme a Pelin.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E74 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 74
programme.desc: Quando Sinan torna all'ospedale per cercare Duygu, l'infermiera gli fa avere un bigliettino da parte della ragazza. Intanto Baris chiede a Pelin di organizzare una cena per conoscere i suoi genitori.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E75 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 75
programme.desc: Mentre sta andando da Baris, Pelin vede Sinan che bacia una donna. Il successivo incontro tra Sinan e Pelin sfocia - prevedibilmente e come sempre - in un'accesa discussione...

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E76 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 76
programme.desc: Mentre Pelin continua la sua relazione col viscido Baris e Sinan ha una bizzarra storia con la sorella dello stesso, il ristorante diventa il teatro delle tensioni e dei risentimenti tra le persone.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E77 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 77
programme.desc: Basak cerca di dimostrare a Bulent che avere dei figli non è una cosa semplice. Intanto il debito di Sinan viene rilevato da un altro strozzino, per volere di Baris.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E78 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 78
programme.desc: La situazione precipita, e Sinan viene portato alla centrale di Polizia con l'accusa di tentato omicidio. Baris decide di diffondere la notizia sui social media, e ingaggia un fotografo.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E79 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 79
programme.desc: Pelin va a trovare Sinan in carcere, nella speranza di convincerlo a chiedere scusa a Baris. Ma Sinan non vuol sentirne nemmeno parlare, e Pelin finisce per perdere anche lei il controllo...

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E80 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 80
programme.desc: Sinan esce dal carcere e trova Bulent che è venuto a prenderlo: i due si chiariscono. Simay, nel frattempo, prende una decisione sulla propria gravidanza, che però Hakan fraintende.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E81 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 81
programme.desc: Pelin non ha ancora accettato la proposta di Baris, che escogita un piano per convincerla a dire di sì. Intanto Sinan è tornato al Filiya, dove trova Serdar al posto suo in cucina...

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E82 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 82
programme.desc: Sinan chiede perdono a Pelin per il male che le ha fatto e le chiede di tornare insieme. Pelin decide di perdonarlo e rifiutare la proposta di matrimonio di Baris. Ma non tutto è ancora a posto...

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 1
programme.desc: Pelin, viene abbandonata all'altare da Tolga. Pelin, convinta che sia colpa di una maledizione, cercherà di ottenere il perdono del vecchio suo compagno universitario Sinan, a cui in passato aveva spezzato il cuore.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 2
programme.desc: Pelin ha capito che Sinan non la perdonerà facilmente ed è pronta a fare qualsiasi cosa lui le chieda. Sinan, intenzionato a farla soffrire, inizia un gioco di vendetta. Ma le cose non andranno bene per nessuno dei due.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 3
programme.desc: Mentre il ristorante iniziava appena a riprendersi, il pignoramento ha avuto l'effetto di una bomba. Ora c'è una sola cosa da fare: trovare i soldi. E in tempi brevissimi. Tutti i dipendenti del ristorante si impegnano con tutte le loro forze per raccogliere il denaro, mentre Pelin si trova davanti a una grande sorpresa.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 4
programme.desc: La grande confusione al Filiya si conclude con la decisione presa da Sinan. Ora c'è un terzo socio nel Filiya: Ceyda. Da questo momento in poi, nulla sarà più come prima. Il ritorno di Tolga è un segno che la maledizione è stata spezzata?

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 5
programme.desc: Pelin discute continuamente con Sinan su come trattare i clienti. Ceyda intanto, per metterla in cattiva luce, le fa perdere la pazienza.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 6
programme.desc: Riza irrompe nel ristorante per portare via Pelin, contro la sua volontà. Sinan cerca di impedirlo, ma invano.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 7
programme.desc: Dopo averla combinata grossa, Necip tenta di nascondersi da Bulent. Ma incontra Meliha, che lo disconosce e contringe Hava a scegliere.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 8
programme.desc: Necip lascia Hava. Pelin e Sinan sembrano essere sereni. Intanto Simay scopre che la donna che scrive a suo marito non è una donna...

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 9
programme.desc: Nel tentativo di riavvicinarsi a Sinan, Pelin gli fa una proposta di lavoro. Intanto Necip inizia a pentirsi di aver lasciato la moglie.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 10
programme.desc: Sisan vede Tolga con un'altra ragazza, ma decide di non rivelarlo a Pelin. Ma il giorno dopo lo passa tutto il giorno con lei.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 11
programme.desc: Dopo la notte passata al ristorante, Pelin e Sinan vengono svegliati da Bulent e Ceyda. Nel frattempo, Riza scopre l'imbroglio.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 12
programme.desc: Tutti sono alla ricerca di Pelin - la sua famiglia, Tolga e le sue amiche - che si crede sia stata rapita da Sinan, anche lui scomparso.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 13
programme.desc: Per allontanare Sinan da Pelin, Ceyda fa spargere la voce che Sinan ha lasciato l'università per colpa di Pelin.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 14
programme.desc: Meliah scopre che il motivo per cui il figlio ha lasciato l'univesità è Pelin. Sinan si affretta a dirle che non rivedrà mai più la ragazza.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 15
programme.desc: Sinan e Pelin sono costretti a rimanere nel ristorante per chiarirsi.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 16
programme.desc: Durante una serata romantica, Pelin e Sinan sono interrotti dall'arrivo di Meliha: Pelin non vuole assolutamente incontrarla e si nasconde.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 17
programme.desc: Necip e Feridun vincono finalmente una grossa somma di denaro ai cavalli. Tolga cerca di riconquistare il cuore di Pelin.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E18 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 18
programme.desc: Pelin riceve la visita di suo padre. Riza è deciso a chiedere il divorzio e annuncia a Pelin che si trasferirà da lei.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 19
programme.desc: Dopo le dure parole della madre di Sinan, Pelin sembra decisa a rinunciare a lui e incoraggiare la sua relazione con Ceyda.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E20 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 20
programme.desc: Dopo aver saputo che Ceyda ha passato la notte da Sinan, Pelin si convince di essere stata presa in giro, e smette di rispondere alle telefonate.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 21
programme.desc: Shueyla e Riza, sempre decisi a divorziare, combattono per conquistare l'amore di Pelin. Che intanto è furente con Sinane.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E22 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 22
programme.desc: Pelin va a casa Berkay e scopre il complotto di Ceyda. Intanto Necip non riesce proprio a perdonare Havva, ma Sinan cerca di convincerlo.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E23 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 23
programme.desc: Tutti gli amici si riuniscono per cercare insieme il modo di aiutare Sinan a restituire i soldi a Ceyda e potersi riprendere il suo ristorante.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E24 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 24
programme.desc: Un momento molto intenso tra Sinan e Pelin viene interrotto dall'arrivo di una vecchia amica di Sinan. Lui è talmente felice di vederla...

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E25 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 25
programme.desc: Dato che deve farsi perdonare per la proposta di matrimonio poco romantica, Hakan decide di fare una bella sorpresa a Simay.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E26 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 26
programme.desc: Il povero Bulent, all'indomani della sua proposta di matrimonio a Basak, spiega a Sinan come tutta la storia non sia stata che un terribile equivoco.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Sweet Revenge | Stagione 1 Episodio 1
programme.desc: Pelin, viene abbandonata all'altare da Tolga. Pelin, convinta che sia colpa di una maledizione, cercherà di ottenere il perdono del vecchio suo compagno universitario Sinan, a cui in passato aveva spezzato il cuore.

programme.desc: Pelin non ha ancora accettato la proposta di Baris, che escogita un piano per convincerla a dire di sì. Intanto Sinan è tornato al Filiya, dove trova Serdar al posto suo in cucina...

programme.title: Suocero scatenato
programme.desc: Un padre, maniaco del lavoro, spera di poter incontrare la figlia durante una sosta a Los Angeles. Scopre però che la ragazza è scomparsa e si ritrova costretto a collaborare con la sua ex goffa fidanzata per ritrovarla. Vivrà così una notte che cambierà per sempre la sua esistenza.

programme.title: Animal 2: Hard Justice
programme.desc: Il gangster James "Animal" Allen sta scontando un ergastolo per omicidio, ma quando scopre che suo figlio è stato incastrato e rischia la galera, si vedrà costretto a tornare al suo violento passato.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: Will ed Eden un tempo si amavano. Dopo aver perso tragicamente il loro figlio, Eden è scomparsa prima di ripresentarsi due anni dopo, di punto in bianco, con un nuovo marito.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Michael Fassbender, candidato all'Oscar, è la star sul grande schermo di questo film d'azione e d'avventura, tratto da una famosa saga di videogiochi.

programme.title: Capone
programme.desc: Gli ultimi anni del noto malvivente Al Capone, quando, a soli 47 anni, dopo dieci anni trascorsi in prigione, comincia a soffrire di demenza e alterna la follia al senso di colpa per i crimini commessi.

programme.title: Women Talking - Il diritto di scegliere
programme.desc: "Women Talking - Il diritto di scegliere" segue un gruppo di donne di un'isolata comunità religiosa mentre cercano di capire come costruire un mondo migliore per sé e i propri figli. Resta e combatti, o scappa. Non resteranno ferme a guardare.

programme.title: The wheather man - l'uomo delle previsioni
programme.desc: David Spritz (Nicholas Cage) sta consumando la propria vita sotto un metaforico diluvio. Separato dalla moglie con la quale ha un rapporto conflittuale, due figli che hanno problemi ad entrare nella società, un padre importante. Non è facile sorridere in questa situazione.

programme.title: Till - il coraggio di una madre
programme.desc: "Till - la giustizia di una madre" è un film molto toccante sulla vera storia dell’incessante ricerca della giustizia da parte di Mamie Till-Mobley, il cui figlio di 14 anni, Emmett Till, in visita ai cugini in Mississippi, fu linciato nel 1955.

programme.title: Io, Dio e Bin Laden
programme.desc: Io, Dio e Bin Laden è tratto da un’incredibile storia vera: quella di Gary Faulkner, statunitense che cercò, per ben undici volte, di stanare Bin Laden con una spada comprata in tv. Incredibile ma vero.

programme.title: Io sono vendetta
programme.desc: Stanley Hill è un ingegnere disoccupato. Un giorno, in un parcheggio, assiste impotente all'omicidio della moglie Vivian. Gibson e gli altri poliziotti coinvolti nel caso non sono interessati realmente a cercare di capire chi possa essere l'assassino e così Stanley decide di rivolgersi al vecchio.

programme.title: Transsiberian
programme.desc: Una coppia di americani, Jessie e Roy, aderenti a una Chiesa protestante che si occupa di aiuto ai bambini in Cina, decide di utilizzare per il ritorno la linea ferroviaria transiberiana.

programme.title: Pig
programme.desc: Rob (Nicolas Cage) è un ex grande chef ritiratosi nelle terre selvagge dell’Oregon. E’ un uomo solitario, un cacciatore di tartufi accompagnato soltanto dal suo amato maiale.

programme.title: Non è mia figlia
programme.desc: La mamma single Sarah si trasferisce in periferia e inizia a frequentare un vigile del fuoco, solo per ritrovarsi oggetto delle ossessive attenzioni di un vigilante del quartiere che vuole dimostrare di essere l'uomo migliore per proteggerla... anche a costo di creare lui stesso il pericolo.

programme.title: Undisputed 4: Il ritorno di Boyka
programme.desc: Yuri Boyka sta portando in alto il suo nome nel mondo dei grandi campionati di combattimento quando una morte accidentale sul ring lo costringe a mettere in discussione tutto ciò che egli rappresenta.

programme.title: Hot Dog: Attacco a Berlino
programme.desc: I due ufficiali del GSG10 Luke e Theo non potrebbero essere più diversi. Ma ora devono unire le forze per salvare Mascha, la figlia di un ambasciatore che è stata rapita e per cui è stato chiesto un ingente riscatto.

programme.title: Amore inaspettato
programme.desc: Bill, scrittore di successo, resta cieco a causa di un incidente stradale, nel quale sua moglie perde la vita. Un giorno si presenta alla sua porta Suzanne, obbligata ai servizi sociali a causa di una condanna penale. All’inizio i due non si piacciono, ma ben presto si scopriranno innamorati.

programme.title: City of Lies - L'ora della verità
programme.desc: Russell Poole è un ex-detective che ha immolato la sua vita e la sua carriera alle indagini su un caso che non è mai riuscito a risolvere, quello degli omicidi delle due star del rap Tupac Shakur e The Notorious B.I.G.

programme.title: Women Talking - Il diritto di scegliere
programme.desc: "Women Talking - Il diritto di scegliere" segue un gruppo di donne di un'isolata comunità religiosa mentre cercano di capire come costruire un mondo migliore per sé e i propri figli. Resta e combatti, o scappa. Non resteranno ferme a guardare.

programme.title: The Assassination - Al Centro Del Complotto
programme.desc: La studentessa più popolare di un liceo cattolico incarica uno studente universitario aspirante giornalista di indagare sugli esami di ammissione al college, che sospetta truccati. Sarà solo l’inizio di una pericolosa avventura.

programme.title: X+Y
programme.desc: Nathan è un giovane ragazzo affetto da una forma di autismo. Il professor Humphreys lo sprona a partecipare alle Olimpiadi della Matematica.

programme.title: American Skin
programme.desc: Il colore della pelle, in America, conta. Conta eccome. Se sei nero. Lincoln Jefferson è un veterano del corpo dei Marines e lavora come custode in un prestigioso liceo della California: un lavoro che si è trovato per garantire l’iscrizione alla scuola del figlio quattordicenne, KJ.

programme.title: Vendetta - Una storia d'amore
programme.desc: Teena viene stuprata mentre sta tornando a casa con la figlia dodicenne Bethie. Quando i carnefici assumono un procuratore famoso per difenderli, l'ufficiale di polizia John Droomor inizia a indagare allo scopo di garantire che la verità venga a galla e che la donna venga protetta dalla giustizia.

programme.title: Imperium
programme.desc: Nate Foster, una giovane recluta dell'FBI, viene accusato dal suo superiore di infiltrarsi in un gruppo neonazista come informatore. Inizialmente riluttante, Nate capisce subito che per guadagnare la fiducia dei membri dell'organizzazione, deve diventare uno di loro.

programme.title: The Dark
programme.desc: Un macello gallese è l'ambientazione di una serie di avvenimenti misteriosi che colpiscono una giovane famiglia tormentata dal fantasma di un bambino che è morto lì.

programme.title: American Pastoral
programme.desc: Seymour Levov ha avuto solo successi nella sua vita. Ma il suo equilibrio perfetto si sconvolge quando la figlia è coinvolta in un attentato terroristico.

programme.title: Third Person
programme.desc: Tre storie di passione, fiducia e tradimento, che prendono vita in tre città diverse, dove si dipanano le vicende di tre coppie che sembrano non avere nulla in comune, se non un invisibile, flebile legame.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Michael Fassbender, candidato all'Oscar, è la star sul grande schermo di questo film d'azione e d'avventura, tratto da una famosa saga di videogiochi.

programme.title: Quel momento imbarazzante
programme.desc: Tre migliori amici si fanno una promessa: quella di restare tutti single. Hanno infatti timore che le relazioni serie possano annullare le loro personalità e far cambiare il loro rapporto di amicizia. Nel momento in cui meno se lo aspettano però tre ragazze gli faranno cambiare idea.

programme.title: Uno per tutti
programme.desc: Un ragazzo di buona famiglia riduce in fin di vita un suo coetaneo, che ora lotta tra la vita e la morte, e per questo finisce in prigione. Così, un cerchio che si era rotto molti anni prima, ora si riapre improvvisamente.

programme.title: The Imitation game
programme.desc: Ritratto intenso e inquietante di un brillante e complesso uomo, THE IMITATION GAME mostra un genio che, sotto una pressione angosciante, ha contribuito a ridurre la durata della guerra e, quindi, a salvare milioni di vite.

programme.title: Dylan Dog
programme.desc: Deciso a lasciare mostri e non morti al loro mondo, l'indagatore dell'incubo Dylan Dog viene richiamato suo malgrado in servizio dalla bionda Elizabeth, per far luce sulla misteriosa morte di suo padre.

Uno milanese, l'altro romano, uno benestante e l'altro nullatenente si conoscono per la prima volta all'imbarco per Praga detestandosi a prima vista.

programme.desc: Il protagonista è un rappresentante annoiato e stanco del proprio lavoro, che non dorme più la notte. Per non cadere in depressione frequenta un gruppo di discussione di malati, grazie ai quali si sente finalmente bene.

programme.title: World Spas
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 World Spas Sarovar Premier, India
programme.desc: Ayurveda, a unique, indispensable branch of medicine is based on the principles of keeping the one’s mind, body and spirit in equilibrium. In Kerala, it isn’t just a health care system, but a way of life and that’s what brings us to Sarovar Premier Spa Retreat.

programme.title: Unwind
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Unwind The Palace Downtown, Dubai
programme.desc: Be it the world’s tallest building or one of the world’s largest man-made marinas, Dubai has always been a city firmly in charge of writing its own story. Renowned traveler, Sabrina discovers this, as she visits Dubai’s own tropical rainforest and a wildlife sanctuary that is home to wild flamingos. She also learns about the city's roots at Bastakiya, the old quarter full of sand-colored houses with open courtyards and narrow alleyways, and Al Fahidi Fort, the city's oldest structure.

programme.title: Great World Hotels
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Great World Hotels One & Only Mauritius
programme.desc: Fringed by 160km of sandy beaches and an azure sea, with a backdrop of rugged peaks and shimmering sugar cane, Mauritius is synonymous with luxury beach breaks. Travel aficionado, Freishia Bomanbehram comes to Saint La Geran, one of the most sought-after luxury hotels in Mauritius, for a break like that.

programme.title: Indonesia's Romantic Getaway
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Indonesia's Romantic Getaway, Borobudur
programme.desc: Amidst ancient temples and misty morning hills, Sangeeta and Manish step into Borobudur’s timeless embrace, where history and serenity intertwine.

programme.title: Quest
programme.sub-title: S01 : E20 Quest Fort Begu 1, India
programme.desc: Hungry for stories and flavours of a bygone kingdom, Alex meets Rana Sawai Harisingh II, the 24th descendant to the royal family of Begu.

programme.title: Bliss
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Bliss Santorini, Greece
programme.desc: Most popular destinations of Santorini's main island are the volcano and the hot spring.This is best way to explore this island is on foot.

programme.title: Best From The Rest
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Best From The Rest Hong Kong Top Sees
programme.desc: While Hong Kong may be a haven for social media brags, a closer look at some of its most iconic attractions exposes its authentic richness.

programme.title: Xplore Czech Republic
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Xplore Czech Republic Kutna Hora
programme.desc: The ancient silver mining town of Kutná Hora was the second most important town in the medieval Kingdom of Bohemia after Prague. Rohan Patoley learns about the erstwhile glories of the town at the former royal mint, the Italian court, and soaks in the romance of the quaint winery, Vinné Sklepy. He also attends the Royal Silvering Festival, an annual Gothic celebration recalling the town’s rich past.

programme.title: Off The Grid
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Off The Grid Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
programme.desc: Emeline visits Lucy and Ardi, the ancestors of mankind, and relishes traditional Ethiopian injera in Addis Ababa, the capital of Ethiopia.

programme.title: 10 Days Sri Lanka
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 10 Days Sri Lanka Colombo
programme.desc: Sabrina Bussandri visits the iconic sights of Colombo, and goes on to take a river safari and visit a turtle hatchery in Bentota.

programme.title: Quest
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Quest Kolkata 2, India
programme.desc: Bengal has not only been home to the former capital of British India but also been the land where many European colonies vied for dominance and cultural supremacy. As a result, the cuisine of the land underwent a renaissance, wherein it imbibed many European influences including Portuguese, Dutch and Danish. Alex visits what used to be a Danish settlement on the banks of the river Hooghly, and she unearths recipes, which were born from this delicious amalgamation of cultures.

programme.title: Off The Grid
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Off The Grid Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
programme.desc: Emeline visits Lucy and Ardi, the ancestors of mankind, and relishes traditional Ethiopian injera in Addis Ababa, the capital of Ethiopia.

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 City Breaks Sofia, Bulgaria
programme.desc: Bulgaria's capital Sofia is one of Europe's most compact and walkable city, with small gardens, parks and cafes sprawled all over.

programme.title: Xplore Czech Republic
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Xplore Czech Republic Pilsen
programme.desc: Pilsen boasts of a majestic Baroque town square and magnificent Gothic churches but to the world, it will always be known as the birthplace of the world’s first and arguably best lager beer, Pilsner Urquell. Rohan Patoley takes the tour of the most famous brewery at the town that has been practicing the art of brewing beer over 700 years.

programme.title: Off The Grid
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Off The Grid Gondar, Ethiopia
programme.desc: Emeline learns about the history of Ethiopia at the Gondar Castle, and goes on to explore the stunning, rock-hewn Lalibela churches.

programme.title: 10 Days Sri Lanka
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 10 Days Sri Lanka Galle
programme.desc: Sabrina Bussandri loses herself in the colonial hangover of Galle

programme.title: Quest
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Quest Kolkata 3, India
programme.desc: The pillowy goodness of Bengali sweets is even more famous in India than some of Kolkata’s landmarks. Alex, however, sets out to discover the forgotten sweets of Bengal. She meets some veteran sweet shop owners in the city, who show her how to make some lesser-known traditional sweets.

programme.title: Off The Grid
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Off The Grid Gondar, Ethiopia
programme.desc: Emeline learns about the history of Ethiopia at the Gondar Castle, and goes on to explore the stunning, rock-hewn Lalibela churches.

programme.title: City breaks
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 City breaks Tashkent, Uzbekistan
programme.desc: Alex Outhwaite visits the iconic city, Tashkent, and gets firsthand experience of its culture, food and people.

programme.title: Xplore Czech Republic
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Xplore Czech Republic Karlovy Vary
programme.desc: Legend has it that Karlovy Vary was founded by the Czech king and Roman emperor Charles IV, who discovered a unique spring here while hunting deer one evening. This historic spa town in Czech Republic is known for the healing power of its thermal springs. Rohan explores a few of them including the Freedom and Rusalka Springs and understands their significance to the town.

programme.title: Off The Grid
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Off The Grid Axum, Ethiopia
programme.desc: Emeline explores the ruins of Aksum, the heart of ancient Ethiopia. Next, she tries the Ethiopian coffee ceremony and hyena feeding in Harar.

programme.title: 10 Days Sri Lanka
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 10 Days Sri Lanka Merissa
programme.desc: Sabrina Bussandri tries whale watching in Mirissa

programme.title: Quest
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 Quest Naila 1, India
programme.desc: Khad Maas is a celebrated Rajasthani dish with war-time origins. Game meat used to be slow-cooked in underground pits created to ensure that the fire could not be seen by enemy troops. Due to its intricate and cumbersome preparation, the dish seldom graces tables in Rajasthan today. Alex learns how to prepare this with the cultural conservationist, Trivikram.

programme.title: Off The Grid
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Off The Grid Axum, Ethiopia
programme.desc: Emeline explores the ruins of Aksum, the heart of ancient Ethiopia. Next, she tries the Ethiopian coffee ceremony and hyena feeding in Harar.

programme.title: City breaks
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 City breaks Tashkent, Uzbekistan
programme.desc: Alex Outhwaite visits the iconic city, Tashkent, and gets firsthand experience of its culture, food and people.

programme.title: Quest
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 Quest Naila 2, India
programme.desc: The sheer ingenuity and artistry of Rajasthani cuisine is an enduring testament to the skill and grim determination of the people who have made their homes in this largely arid land. Alex finds out that this applies to the imperial cuisine of the state as well, when she meets Trivikram and learns from him how to prepare a traditional meat dish, that was made using meat leftovers.

programme.title: Xplore Czech Republic
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Xplore Czech Republic Cesky Krumlov
programme.desc: Situated on the banks of the Vltava river, Český Krumlov is a fine example of a European medieval town. Rohan witnesses the Gothic, Renaissance and Baroque elements of the stunning State Castle, which dominates the city. He also finds out about the unconventional life and work of the world-famous painter, whose art was once inspired by this fairytale town in mysterious ways.

programme.desc: Emeline goes to Ruka-Kuusamo, where she tries river rafting. She also meets a reindeer herder,who tells her about the unique ways of herding reindeer.

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Xplore Bhutan Thimpu
programme.desc: Actress and travel enthusiast, Radhika Bangia explores the enigma that is Bhutan, when she visits Thimpu, the capital city with no traffic lights and no skyscrapers invading the skyline. Here, she checks out significant sights such as the Tibetan-style National Memorial Chorten, the National Library and the Folk Heritage Museum in order to understand more about the beliefs, history, architecture and cuisine of Bhutan.

programme.title: World Heritage
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 World Heritage Ancient Temples of Egypt, Egypt (ENG)
programme.desc: Explore the ancient heritage sites of Abu Simbel, the Philae complex of Nubia and the Hatshepsut Temple to unravel the mystical stories behind the ancient temples of Egypt.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun

programme.desc: Alex tries traditional Dutch food in Leiden, learns about Dutch history at Prinsenhof Museum, visits a Gothic church, a local cheese market and Delftware factory at Gouda.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 10 Days Scotland Isle Of Skye (ENG)

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Xplore Bhutan Phobjikha
programme.desc: Known as Druk Yul or the “Land of the Thunder Dragon”, Bhutan is the country of mountains, monasteries and mystery. Radhika Bangia finds this to be true when she visits Punakha, the former capital of Bhutan, where she marvels at the architecture of Punakha Dzong and gets to know the story behind the two rivers, Mo Chhu and Po Chhu. She also explores the sacred temples and Mebar Tsho lake of Bumthang, the religious heart of Bhutan, and gets to know the local legends.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 10 Days Scotland Edinburgh (ENG)
programme.desc: Robbie’s journey to reconnect with his Scottish roots begins in Edinburgh, the stunning capital city perched on extinct volcanoes. Navigating the twists of the Royal Mile, strutting around the majestic Edinburgh castle and learning to sip scotch like a true Scotsman, he feels a tad closer to his heritage. The real fun kicks in, however, when he stumbles onto a rather flamboyant way to unleash his inner Highlander.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Xplore Bulgaria Plovdiv
programme.desc: Like Rome, Plovdiv straddles seven hills; but as Europe’s oldest continuously inhabited city, it’s far more ancient. As Catriona takes a tour of the city to see its iconic attractions such as a Roman Amphitheatre, which was once the setting for gladiator fights, and the striking Baroque Saints Constantine and Helena Church, she begins to see how seamlessly modern life blends with the age-old ruins. Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Boarding Pass Ruka Kuusamo, Finland
programme.desc: Emeline goes to Ruka-Kuusamo, where she tries river rafting. She also meets a reindeer herder,who tells her about the unique ways of herding reindeer.

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Xplore Bhutan Thimpu
programme.desc: Actress and travel enthusiast, Radhika Bangia explores the enigma that is Bhutan, when she visits Thimpu, the capital city with no traffic lights and no skyscrapers invading the skyline. Here, she checks out significant sights such as the Tibetan-style National Memorial Chorten, the National Library and the Folk Heritage Museum in order to understand more about the beliefs, history, architecture and cuisine of Bhutan.

programme.title: World Heritage
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 World Heritage Ancient Temples of Egypt, Egypt (ENG)
programme.desc: Explore the ancient heritage sites of Abu Simbel, the Philae complex of Nubia and the Hatshepsut Temple to unravel the mystical stories behind the ancient temples of Egypt.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Food Fact Fun Gouda, Netherlands
programme.desc: Alex tries traditional Dutch food in Leiden, learns about Dutch history at Prinsenhof Museum, visits a Gothic church, a local cheese market and Delftware factory at Gouda.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 10 Days Scotland Isle Of Skye (ENG)
programme.desc: The grand finale of Robbie’s wild homecoming unfolds amidst the rugged beauty of the Isle of Skye.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia
programme.sub-title: S01 : E31 Backpack Resavsk Pecina, Serbia
programme.desc: Continue exploring Serbia with Heather as she visits the Manasija monastery, Resavska caves, ending with a joyride onboard Eight of Sargan rail line.

programme.title: With Love From Mauritius
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 With Love From Mauritius Ep 1
programme.desc: Krisann and Nathan’s vacation in Mauritius begins in Le Morne, where an unexpected adventure awaits the latter.

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Xplore Bhutan Phobjikha
programme.desc: Known as Druk Yul or the “Land of the Thunder Dragon”, Bhutan is the country of mountains, monasteries and mystery. Radhika Bangia finds this to be true when she visits Punakha, the former capital of Bhutan, where she marvels at the architecture of Punakha Dzong and gets to know the story behind the two rivers, Mo Chhu and Po Chhu. She also explores the sacred temples and Mebar Tsho lake of Bumthang, the religious heart of Bhutan, and gets to know the local legends.

programme.title: World Spas
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 World Spas Kempenki, Jordan (ENG)
programme.desc: Jamie Srubis tries out spa treatments, which are inspired by the Dead Sea and the desert surroundings at Hotel Kempinski Ishtar in Jordan.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Food Fact Fun Dubai 1
programme.desc: After Burj Khalifa, Alex has a traditional Emirati platter, visits the gold market and skiing rink, and goes for a camel safari and camping.

programme.title: City break
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 City Breaks Innsbruck, Austria
programme.desc: Nestled in the mighty Alps, tour the Austrian city of Innsbruck with Sabrina and explore a town that’s alpine-urban yet traditional in nature.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia
programme.sub-title: S01 : E32 Backpack Sjenica, Serbia
programme.desc: In her final leg of journey, Heather visits the Uvac canyon, tries locally prepared pie, ending with Kopaonik National Park and Jelovarnik waterfalls.

programme.title: With Love From Mauritius
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 With Love From Mauritius Ep 2
programme.desc: On an island-hopping adventure in Mauritius, Krisann and Nathan find out that time works differently on these islands.

programme.title: XP Guide
programme.sub-title: S01 : E26 XP Guide Copenhagen, Denmark
programme.desc: A homely place where the aroma of freshly baked bread greets you as people smoothly glide along on their bicycles. Welcome to Copenhagen.

programme.title: Unwind
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Unwind Hotel Oriole, Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Indeya explores the Cinnamon plantations, tries a local dish and witnesses a traditional dance performance.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Food Fact Fun Dubai 2
programme.desc: Alex has varied experiences in Dubai like trying Lebanese cheese bread, visiting a coffee museum, going to IMG Worlds of Adventure and more.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Food Fact Fun Amsterdam, Netherlands
programme.desc: In Amsterdam, Alex tries Bitterballen, cannabis cake and visits Heineken Experience brewery. He explores Zaanse Schans village with windmills and Coster Diamonds, the oldest diamond polishing factory.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 10 Days Scotland Edinburgh (ENG)
programme.desc: Robbie’s journey to reconnect with his Scottish roots begins in Edinburgh, the stunning capital city perched on extinct volcanoes. Navigating the twists of the Royal Mile, strutting around the majestic Edinburgh castle and learning to sip scotch like a true Scotsman, he feels a tad closer to his heritage. The real fun kicks in, however, when he stumbles onto a rather flamboyant way to unleash his inner Highlander.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Xplore Bulgaria Plovdiv
programme.desc: Like Rome, Plovdiv straddles seven hills; but as Europe’s oldest continuously inhabited city, it’s far more ancient. As Catriona takes a tour of the city to see its iconic attractions such as a Roman Amphitheatre, which was once the setting for gladiator fights, and the striking Baroque Saints Constantine and Helena Church, she begins to see how seamlessly modern life blends with the age-old ruins. Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

programme.title: XP Guide
programme.sub-title: S01 : E29 XP Guide, Stockholm
programme.desc: Stockholm, the capital and largest city of Sweden, was built on 14 Islands. This place is also sometimes referred as Venice of the north.

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 City Breaks, Prague
programme.desc: This exhilarating city of castles, beer and segway rides can take you on a break that will truly leave you catching your breath.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia
programme.sub-title: S01 : E26 Backpack Belgrade, Serbia
programme.desc: Visit Belgrade, with Heather as she explores the city, its architecture and learns about its past by visiting historical monuments.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 Angry Planet | Kenya
programme.desc: Definitely our wildest episode so far. Here’s the deal: Mt. Elgon is an 14,000 foot volcano in eastern Kenya. We propose a safari/ascent of the dormant volcano. Here’s the first kicker: High on the the flanks of the volcano is Kitum Cave – a cave created by the most unique form of erosion – Elephant Erosion. For millennia elephants have been going into the cave to carve it out with their tusks in order to eat the salty rock. Here’s the second kicker: the cave is thought to be the home of the Ebola Marberg virus – the world’s most deadly virus. So here’s the plan: We are going enter the cave, at night, wearing full Bio-Hazard suits to protect us from the virus.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E05 - Fireside Fortune
programme.desc: Using up the last of their energy, the Keefer brothers make their way down stream in search of their next supply cache. The tide turns as they finally make their way out of the open tundra and into the heart of moose country.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E05 - Masters of Attack
programme.desc: Carnivores can't just pick their meals off trees. To survive, they have to use every trick they've got to catch food that's just as keen on staying alive as they are. If their prey hides, they have to find it. If it runs, they must chase it. They have to track it if it's hard to pin down and beat it if it fights back. The predator might use its strength for the final blow, but the real effort lies in the strategy.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E06 - Devious Defenses
programme.desc: Animals can employ a number of different defenses in order to withstand an attack. Some seek safety in herds, some hide in plain sight, some meet aggression with even stronger aggression, and some build fortresses. Whatever the strategy it is clear that animals will do whatever it takes to survive the wild.

programme.title: Life on the Edge - S01:E03 - Engine Trouble
programme.desc: Bad weather in the Aleutians has stranded Charlie Summerville and his construction team at Volcano Bay, while Pat Harvie's old cars are having engine issues.

programme.title: Life on the Edge - S01:E04 - Building a Wilderness Cabin
programme.desc: At Volcano Bay, nerves begin to fray for Charlie Summerville and his team as they embark on constructing the wilderness cabin.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E01 - Empty Handed
programme.desc: In remote areas, survival is an everyday game. Enter hosts Chris and Casey Keefer as they set out to survive 30 days in the backcountry. Each new day these brothers will pit their skills as hunters, woodsmen, and fishermen against an unforgiving and relentless landscape. DROPPED brings viewers face to face with the harsh reality of only being able to eat what you can kill. A true test of survival. The Keefer brothers put boots to ground as their journey through Alaska begins. Armed with nothing but a couple Glock 20s, the brothers immediately begin their search for their first supply-yielding catch.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E02 - Long Days, Cold Nights
programme.desc: The Keefer brothers awaken to a frozen tundra. With over 8 miles to cover and no oars, the brothers are forced to trudge their way through shallow water and barren earth as they head downstream in search of their second cache.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E03 - Choke Point
programme.desc: The terrain begins to change as the Keefer brothers are forced to pick their way downstream. The landscape tightens it's grip and funnels the brothers to a geographic choke point where both predator and prey gather.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E04 - Bone Weary
programme.desc: The Keefer brothers take shelter in a small pine outcropping as a winter storm sets siege to the river. Forced to wait out the arctic blast, the brothers try and retain what little energy they have left.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess
programme.desc: Diana's fashion sense was something people often looked at closely. She had a knack for picking outfits that were both stylish and sophisticated, which always grabbed attention. Her hats were another standout feature; she often wore elegant designs that added a touch of grace to her look. Her hair was also iconic, usually styled neatly with a slight bounce, perfectly framing her face and adding to her elegant appearance.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E33 - Prince Edward and Sophie Rhys-Jones
programme.desc: The Real Story takes us inside a simple royal love tale. It offers a glimpse behind the scenes of how a Prince ended up falling for a girl from a regular middle-class family.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E01 - Alpine Ghosts
programme.desc: Mario takes on the unforgiving alpine mountains of the south island of New Zealand in a fallow deer hunt with his bow, and cooks an impressive venison pie dish.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E02 - Deadly Outback
programme.desc: In the outback of Australia where everything is trying to kill you. It's monsoon season when no one attempts to roam around with salt water crocodiles lurking. Mario links up with a long time friend in search of a wild Buffalo.

programme.title: Wardens - S07:E07 - Interstate Travel
programme.desc: To slow the spread of CWD, or chronic wasting disease, Michigan conservation officers work Opening Day to make sure no deer come in from infected states; the Wildlife Disease Lab checks suspect deer.

programme.title: Wardens - S07:E08 - Dog and Decoys
programme.desc: Montana wardens use everything from a deer decoy to a K-9 to make sure hunters are following the rules.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E06 - The Ice Giants
programme.desc: Beyond the asteroid belt lay the ice giants, some can be seen with the naked eye, others only glimpsed once by a passing probe. We are again sending cameras to the edge of the solar system giving us The New insights into the evolution of our worlds.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E07 - The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: These are the the Moon's of the gas giants. Each a unique and mysterious world of its own. Some have oceans of water, geysers of Sulphur or atmospheres of plastic. Some are just now being seen at the outer rim of our solar system, all are worthy of much more scrutiny.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E12 - Venice and Northern Ireland
programme.desc: Venice, one of Europe’s most iconic and enchanting cities with its labyrinth of waterways and canals linking one hundred and eighteen separate islands. From Venetians to visitors, it’s the city where everyone oozes style. Then on to Northern Ireland, for a ghostly trail around a haunted hotel and a walk on the road to Winterfel, visiting some of the iconic locations featured HBO’s Games of Thrones series.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E13 - Barbados and Lake Como
programme.desc: Barbados has it all. Home to The Cliff, one of the world’s most famous restaurants where sharks swim in the floodlit bay and entertain diners. Considered by many to be the best of the Caribbean Islands it is home to media moguls and pop princesses alike. Italy’s Lake Como also plays host to a number of famous Hollywood stars and directors who’ve fallen in love with its breath-taking vistas and fabulous cuisine.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E35 - Prince Charles At 50 Heir To Sadness
programme.desc: After Diana's death, everyone's attention turned to Charles, who was not only a widower and a dad but also next in line for the throne. This show takes a closer look at how he got along with his sons, his longtime love Camilla, and what his future might look like as King. Royal experts David Starkey and Anthony Holden share their insights.

Italy’s Lake Como also plays host to a number of famous Hollywood stars and directors who’ve fallen in love with its breath-taking vistas and fabulous cuisine.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E35 - Prince Charles At 50 Heir To Sadness
programme.desc: After Diana's death, everyone's attention turned to Charles, who was not only a widower and a dad but also next in line for the throne. This show takes a closer look at how he got along with his sons, his longtime love Camilla, and what his future might look like as King. Royal experts David Starkey and Anthony Holden share their insights.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E44 - 50 Glorious Years A Royal Celebration
programme.desc: Honoring 50 years of marriage between Her Majesty the Queen and her husband, Prince Philip of Greece and Denmark, the Duke of Edinburgh.

programme.title: Harry & Meghan: A Very Modern Romance
programme.desc: Meghan Markle and Prince Harry share similar interests and seem like a perfect match. Both have faced tough times growing up but have come out on top. Now they're winning together. This hour-long special, featuring a chat with author Andrew Morton, explores the social backdrop that makes their bold marriage fit right in with today's British Royal Family.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E03 - Up with the Gods - Himalayan Tahr
programme.desc: Mario teams up with good friend and precision rifle expert Bernard and heads into the high alpine mountains above New Zealand's rugged West Coast. Drawing on his Greek roots, Mario cooks a rustic Kleftiko dish in an earth oven.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E04 - Outback Odyssey
programme.desc: In one of the harshest environments on the planet, Mario travels to the outback desert of Australia in search of feral camels that have been running rampant. What seemingly feels to be a a simple task quickly turns into one of the hardest and most unexpected challenges he has taken on. With a bow in hand and scorching heat he explores the great dividing range, in hope of harvesting one of these middle eastern based beasts.

programme.title: Wardens - S07:E09 - Deer Patrol Brothers
programme.desc: During opening week, COs and brothers Bill and Shane Webster patrol the state using vastly different strategies; Bill goes on aerial patrol looking for illegal bait piles while Shane works the web to track down offenders.

programme.title: Wardens - S07:E10 - Rural Road Huntin
programme.desc: Opening week of firearms deer season is extremely active; officers in districts three and six tackle road hunting issues in rural Michigan.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E08 - The Sun
programme.desc: It powers the machinery of nature; our weather, encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. When it sets in the West it reveals to us its many billions of sibling stars populating the night sky. We study our Sun closely, and like a Rosetta stone it can reveal the secrets of all the other stars above.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E09 - Exo Planets
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer closer at nearby stars with ever more fidelity they are discovering planets; exo planets, worlds outside our own solar system. With technological advances and improved techniques scientists are discovering more and more worlds every day. With confidence scientists now calculated there could be as many as 40 billion Earth like planets in our Milky Way galaxy alone.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E01 - Terry's Criminal Mind
programme.desc: A murderer tries to kill his final victim as the car they are in slowly sinks to the bottom of a lake. The only way to save the victim is to rescue her as the car continues to sink. We test fire multiple handguns underwater to see if you can actually penetrate a car windshield and save the victim.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E02 - Shark Go Boom!
programme.desc: In Jaws, Chief Brody hangs on to his sinking boat as a giant shark approaches him with a scuba tank lodged in its mouth. We construct a giant shark on a motorized platform to test if you can hit, and explode, the tank with an M1 Garand rifle while perched in a precarious position.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E08 - Princess Diana The Uncrowned Queen
programme.desc: This show offers a captivating look into the extraordinary life of one of the 20th century's most fascinating women, seen through an American lens. It features clips from the auction where her dresses were sold.
